name: cybro-recorder
description: Desktop call recorder for web meetings — microphone + system audio to WAV.
author: Cybro

scripts.typecheck: node --check src/main/main.js && node --check src/main/preload.js && node --check src/main/paths.js && node --check src/main/permissions.js && node --check src/renderer/app.js && node --check src/renderer/audio/recorder.js && node --check src/renderer/audio/wav-encoder.js && node --check src/shared/constants.js

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cybro Recorder needs the microphone to capture your side of web calls.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Cybro Recorder needs system audio access to capture the other side of web calls.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureDescription: Cybro Recorder may use screen-capture APIs on macOS to obtain system/loopback audio during calls.
